hero.title: Family and Social Arraigo
hero.subtitle: Guidance and support for individuals seeking to regularize their immigration status in Spain through family ties, social circumstances, or other applicable arraigo pathways.

helps.title: How We Can Help With Your Arraigo
helps.subtitle: We provide personalized guidance throughout the arraigo process, from assessing your eligibility to preparing and submitting your application.

eligibility.title: Eligibility Assessment
eligibility.description: We review your personal circumstances and help identify the arraigo pathway that best fits your situation.

documentation.title: Document Preparation
documentation.description: We guide you through the required documentation and help ensure your supporting evidence is properly prepared.

application.title: Application Assistance
application.description: We assist with the preparation and submission of your arraigo application and help you navigate the administrative requirements.

followUp.title: Case Follow-Up
followUp.description: We help you stay informed throughout the process and provide guidance on the next steps after submitting your application.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Arraigo Process?
cta.subtitle: Take the next step toward regularizing your situation in Spain. Contact our team to discuss your circumstances and learn how we can assist you throughout the arraigo process.
